sources.name: Trustpilot
sources.scope: Company-wide (&Soul) — covers Southall, Shoreditch and the Sanctuary wellness space
sources.label: Great

reviews.author: Matiullah Khan
reviews.title: Scam place and fraudulent team working
reviews.text: Appalling service, unlawful deductions and negligent conditions. Tried to withhold £81 from my deposit for a portable over-the-door hook that caused no damage. Broken room air conditioner during the hottest days of summer, broken toilet shower that wouldn't flush properly. Emails about urgent issues completely ignored. Booking #20260508-00011.

reviews.author: Freed
reviews.title: The front of house staff Tamika was…
reviews.text: The front of house staff Tamika was lively and efficient and let me know exactly what I needed to do to check in properly.

reviews.author: Aziz Masood
reviews.title: 11th-Floor Rat Infestation, Unsafe Premises & Unlawfully Withheld Deposits
reviews.text: Active rat infestation inside my room on the 11th floor; pest control took three days because there is no pest control on weekends. Reception refused to rehouse us immediately. AC failed during a heatwave with no in-room control, windows sealed shut. Out of three lifts at least one permanently out of service. Laundry facilities filthy, razor blade in a washing machine. Still chasing deposit and unused rent after the 14-working-day period. Licence agreement, not a tenancy.

reviews.author: Esin Cansu Yilmaz
reviews.title: One star
reviews.text: Visited the wellness space, booked the £29 discovery package for sauna and cold plunge. Changing room packed with a muddy floor, twenty people sharing six cold plunge stations in un-rinsed water, no showering required, sauna dangerously overcrowded with no health screening. Raised it in detail afterwards and got no response — ghosted.

reviews.author: Ben
reviews.title: Disappointing does not begin to…
reviews.text: Paid a deposit, signed a contract and passed referencing, then received a generic email at 3pm on a Friday four days before move-in saying the booking was cancelled due to a maintenance issue, with no alternative offered. Left effectively homeless and out of pocket. Deposit not refunded as promised; emails to the memberships team ignored. Booking 20260615-00006.

reviews.author: ST
reviews.title: Yasmeen
reviews.text: Yasmeen is the most kind hearted individual. Extremely proactive and helpful, resolves problems immediately and is always there for a quick chat to put a smile on your face.

reviews.author: Emma Goldie
reviews.title: Yasmeen from Day 1 has been present…
reviews.text: Yasmeen from day 1 has been present, kind, thoughtful, chatty, sensitive and gone above and beyond to make me feel comfortable. She's a blessing.

reviews.author: Rai Khan
reviews.title: Shes amazing charasmastic I loved…
reviews.text: Yasmin is amazing and charismatic, I loved getting help from her, she's very professional. Definitely value added to Soul.

reviews.author: Kamal qadir khan
reviews.title: Yasmeen is an amazing person
reviews.text: Yasmeen is an amazing person. She helped me with everything I needed.

reviews.author: Maria Ranaldi
reviews.title: Yasmeen
reviews.text: Currently staying at &Soul Southall. A friendly place with a community vibe, a short distance from Heathrow airport. The staff are really helpful, especially Yasmeen in reception who is always welcoming, professional and kind.

reviews.author: sahar
reviews.title: Yasmin the great social host
reviews.text: I love connecting with Yasmin since the beginning of my experience — always supportive and welcoming.

reviews.author: Fathi Mohamoud
reviews.title: Great company to work
reviews.text: Great company to work for! Been here for 3 months, love it.

reviews.author: Spurs Football team (Mini dele ali)
reviews.title: Top of the line
reviews.text: The sauna and cold plunge is unbelievable, as good as a 5 star hotel. The workers are super kind and the pilates and TRX studios are great exercise. Great vibe, super chill and cool.

reviews.author: Crypto Chev - Instagram
reviews.title: The security team are so professional…
reviews.text: The security team are so professional and ultra helpful — Christian especially is amazing and his knowledge always on point. Yasmin is so professional and helpful, often going far and beyond to guide and assist residents, always smiling and giving good advice.

reviews.author: Yoleme Efih
reviews.title: Tamika
reviews.text: Tamika was wonderful, very nice and sweet, she helped me understand the laundry room so well. A great asset to Southall &Soul.

reviews.author: Marcos de Freitas - Datta Büsi
reviews.title: Everything is as they told me.
reviews.text: Everything is as they told me. The rooms are good. The place is big and everything works as expected. The team is always ready to attend and helpful. A place to live and use as a member.

reviews.author: Julie Hardman
reviews.title: Wow...wow....wow
reviews.text: A truly magical place to stay with great links to Heathrow Airport (all terminals). Warm and friendly atmosphere. Never stayed anywhere with facilities like this: gym, sauna, outdoor gardens, meditation room, podcast room, pool and table tennis, bar, DJ.

reviews.author: adnan s
reviews.title: I visited Andsoul South Hall yesterday…
reviews.text: Visited to meet a friend — warm and welcoming atmosphere, comfortable without being crowded. Staff friendly and attentive, didn't feel rushed. Would come back, highly recommend as a chill and pleasant place to spend time with friends.

reviews.author: Sam Ellis
reviews.title: Started hesitant but now can't see myself leaving!
reviews.text: Moved in for a month to suss out London and have now signed up till the end of the year. Everything under one roof: sauna, gym, co-working, but mostly a great community — made many friends for life. Management are making regular improvements to the facilities and take on board feedback from residents.

reviews.author: Lucy Morgen
reviews.title: I am extremely disappointed with how…
reviews.text: Advertised very differently from the reality. General manager behaves unprofessionally and gives privileges to her partner and children. Vulnerable residents with mobility issues pushed out. Ventilation does not work properly, no windows, poor air quality. Lifts frequently break down and residents get stuck. Fire door checks handled rudely. Main gate broken. Question the authenticity of positive reviews from staff.

reviews.author: Anders
reviews.title: Southall &Soul has been a…
reviews.text: A transformative living experience so far — three weeks in and loving it, have made so many connections and new friends. Staff supportive, present and kind. Great view from the 8th floor and the community food is a special treat. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Erin
reviews.title: WARNING: do not stay here
reviews.text: Loved the concept — friendly community, coworking, sauna and cold plunge, free dinners, pilates and yoga — but basic broken amenities made it a negative experience. First room's air con and vents didn't work in 35+ degrees, windows don't open, couldn't move rooms until Monday. Broken ovens, malfunctioning lift with people stuck. Second room's electricity kept tripping and I was brushed off 12+ times before an electrician came. Third room was dirty with black marks in the shower and a hole in the wall. Brown murky water from the shower tap. Contract price didn't match the Airbnb price paid. Worst accommodation experience of my life.

reviews.author: Kjær Dían
reviews.title: This is a pretty unique and special place
reviews.text: Obvious teething problems as highlighted by other reviews, but an ambitious venture. Spent just over a week and had a life-changingly awesome time; met around 20 new people and made friends for life. Yoga studio, saunas, terrace, cafe and communal area available to everyone. Shout outs to Nicola, Cody, Leyth and Jordi. Landed with a free delicious community meal. Pricing isn't bad either.

reviews.author: Marie T Auckland
reviews.title: Terrible and Health & Safety concern
reviews.text: Staff lack experience troubleshooting; lovely but not a lot of common sense. Ventilation system a serious health and safety concern with windows that can't be opened — room reading at 26 degrees, had to seek urgent medical care as I was struggling to breathe. Large leak from the window area saturating the carpet on level 6. Took over two weeks to move me to another room, which was then extremely cold. Security guard harassed and belittled me during the room inspection. No workable solution from sales or management.

reviews.author: Peter
reviews.title: Stylish Branding Masks Poor Management, Awkward Community, and Deposit Delays
reviews.text: Photographs well but rooms are tiny, ventilation poor, maintenance patchy. Kitchen almost unusable: filthy fridges, one working oven for ~300 guests. Three lifts very slow, usually only one working. Breakfast served late and mainly toast. Community vibe feels forced with pseudo-wellness programming. Reception staff friendly but frustrated with top-down management. Security deposit refunds delayed around two months, not protected by a government scheme, licensee rather than tenant.

highlights.author: Abdulrazak
highlights.text: Excellent location, Jasmin and Mohamed were good to me throughout my stay, they gave an excellent service as well. Breakfast was basic.

highlights.author: James
highlights.text: I had family travelling into Heathrow for a few days and the property made sense with how close it was to the airport. Getting around was pretty easy with the Elizabeth line and the bus routes.

highlights.author: Suado
highlights.text: The apartments are affordable and very high quality. It is also close to Heathrow airport. The staff were very welcoming.

highlights.author: Mylists
highlights.text: Loved the sauna and the gym and the daily breakfast, it was great and affordable.
